items.title: Manuel Paul Interview, 1960-04-19
items.q: This Trapania. ... Yeah, good picture of him.

ctx.x: No, that's just the pose. Oh, okay. But we had a hall there we rehearsed in. Well, they had fellas during the time of this picture there, they had fellas in there couldn't run a C scale. Mm-hmm. But they was musicians. Uh-huh. Now this Professor Carter. Down on the front sitting down in the suit. Yeah, sitting down there. Yeah, sitting down there. This Trapania.
Well, that's Trapania sitting in the, in back of the snare drum, first snare drum on the left. That's right, that's right. Kind of a stout fellow.
Yeah, good picture of him. Mm-hmm. Now you ever heard talk of Oinness Pinn, banjo player? I think so. Well, that's, that, that's what's one fellow. Ernest? Pinn's. Pinn's. Just like Samuel Pinn's.
